responsibility: Declares the core classes, enums, flags, and helper structures that make up the RVV builtin framework. It defines the abstractions for function instances, operand and predication kinds, builtin type metadata, function builders, shapes, bases, checkers, folders, and expanders, as well as extension-requirement bits and shared inline helpers, serving as the main internal API for the vector intrinsic implementation.
same_name_distinction: Among the `riscv-vector-builtins` files, this header defines the shared internal API and data model of the RVV builtin subsystem: enums, core classes like `function_instance`, `function_base`, `function_shape`, and helper interfaces used across the implementation. Unlike `.cc`, it is not the registration/dispatch engine, and unlike `.def`, it is not a pure macro data table.
